rules: Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for all headings with tracking-tight (-0.02em to -0.04em).
Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for body and tabular data. It gives a sharp, corporate tech feel.
Use tracking-[0.2em] uppercase for overlines and small labels.
Use stark white/black contrasts. 95% of UI should be monochrome, with color existing only to guide action.
Use status colors specifically for badges, workflow nodes, and critical buttons.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (Technical Look) & Neumorphism for cards. Expose the skeleton. Dashboards should use 1px solid borders and subtle shadow-sm. No muddy gray transparencies.
visual_enhancers.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) - great for dense dashboards and corporate tech look.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Slight lift (-translate-y-0.5) and border color darkens/lightens. Always explicitly set text color on hover.

layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid Mode B (High Density). Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
layouts.navigation: Collapsible left-sidebar for modular scaling. Keep it dark or highly contrasted from the main background.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards to avoid text collision.
patterns: Modified F-pattern: Top-left for 'Pending Approvals Count'.
Workflow Routing Logic: Use a horizontal or vertical stepper (Sales -> CGO -> Finance -> Legal -> CFO) to visualize the proposal route.
Split View: Left side list of proposals, right side details panel (Risk & Impact, Audit Trail/Comments).

components.workflow_stepper: A custom horizontal or vertical stepper showing the 5 stages. Use solid filled circles for completed, blinking/glowing circle (tracing beam effect) for active stage, and empty circles for pending.
components.audit_trail: A timeline widget showing who approved/rejected, with timestamps and comments.
components.data_table: Shadcn UI table but customized to remove default Vercel-look. Add sharp 1px borders. Use badges for status.
components.action_panel: A sticky bottom or top-right panel in the proposal detail view with primary CTA (Approve) and secondary (Reject/Send back to Sales).

rules: Staggered entrance for list items in the proposal feed.
Smooth layout transitions when switching tabs (Pending vs Approved).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Normal text min 4.5:1 contrast, large text min 3:1.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a React dashboard app with multiple roles: Sales, CGO, CFO, Finance, Legal.
Implement a mock login screen to switch between these roles.
Dashboard should have a Sidebar (Dashboard, Pending Approvals, Approved, Users - Finance only).
Finance user is Super Admin and can see the 'Users' tab to manage accounts.
Create a 'New Proposal' modal/page available only to the Sales role.
Implement the multi-stage approval workflow: Sales -> CGO -> Finance -> Legal -> CFO.
In the Proposal Details view, show the document info, the 5-step visual stepper, and the Action Panel (Approve/Reject with comments) if it's the current user's turn.
A rejection ('Send back to Sales') resets the workflow or puts it in a 'Needs Revision' state for Sales.
Once CFO approves, move it to the 'Approved' folder.
Ensure all components use Shadcn UI primitives but styled with the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' monochrome aesthetic.
DO NOT use Inter font for headings; stick to the specified typography.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only for fixed headers/nav, otherwise use flat crisp panels.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like sharp or slightly rounded corners with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot, brain, lightbulb, etc for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
